summary: Borr Drilling Ltd completed a $300M offering of 3.50% convertible senior notes due 2033, including a $40M over-allotment. The notes convert at $8.00/share (over 40% premium to the $5.70 closing price on April 14, 2026). Proceeds will repurchase $195.2M of its existing 2028 convertible bonds and for general corporate purposes. The senior unsecured notes mature May 1, 2033, interest payable semi-annually. This debt-for-debt exchange reduces near-term maturities and overhang. Watch for impact on diluted share count and any additional repurchases; risk-arb narrow as it's a refinancing, not a control event.
